instructions: Virtual-display automation for Windows apps. The server mounts a virtual display on demand (default 1280x720; override at startup with VSP_DISPLAY_WIDTH/HEIGHT/REFRESH, or at runtime with `set_display`) and only operates windows it has tracked. Start with `snapshot` (semantic tree + dialogs + optional screenshot); it returns a snapshot_id and refs. Prefer semantic actions (click_ref/invoke_element/set_element_value) over pixel coordinates. Coordinates must stay inside the virtual display. Chromium/WebView2 apps ignore window messages; for click/click_ref/click_text pass `channel=input` or `fallback_input=true`, and for gesture pass `mode=input`. `auto` never moves the real cursor unless fallback_input or VSP_INPUT_AUTOFALLBACK=1 enables it. If a dialog is not reachable, use `list_windows` then `launch_or_place_app(hwnd=...)`; use `get_processes` and `wait_for(type=process)` for long-running installers/builds instead of polling from the shell. Run `release_environment` when finished; the display is kept by default. This is a shared desktop session, not a security sandbox; use a VM for untrusted work. run_script is disabled unless the server was started with --allow-script.

tools.name: assert_region
tools.title: Assert region
tools.description: Assert color coverage or change against a baseline. An explicit baseline_frame_id must match x/y/width/height exactly; mismatch returns E_NO_BASELINE instead of comparing different areas.

tools.name: capture_screen
tools.title: Capture screen
tools.description: Capture the virtual display or a region. Returns a PNG plus meta. If save_path is given it is the only output file; otherwise large frames are written to the session artifact directory and returned as a resource link. inline=true (default) embeds small images and a 0.25x preview for large ones. save_path must be an absolute .png under the working directory or temp.

scale.description: Default 0.5 for full screen, 1 for regions.

inline.description: Embed the PNG in the MCP result. Default true for small images.

save_path.description: Absolute .png path under cwd or temp.

tools.name: click
tools.title: Click
tools.description: Click at virtual-desktop coordinates. channel=auto tries a UIA element, then a window message; it only falls back to SendInput when fallback_input=true (or VSP_INPUT_AUTOFALLBACK=1). Non-client areas (title bar, caption buttons) and popup menus are handled explicitly. keep_foreground=true pauses the focus guard for 30s.

fallback_input.description: Default false. When UIA/message paths fail, move the real cursor and use SendInput.

context_menu.description: Default false. After a right-button message click, also send WM_CONTEXTMENU with screen coordinates. Needed by legacy/self-drawn trees that only react to WM_CONTEXTMENU.

interval_ms.description: Default 50. Gap between clicks in a multi-click on channel=input; raise it for slow self-drawn controls.

observe.description: Default true: capture a small before/after diff and return observed.changed.

tools.name: click_ref
tools.title: Click element by ref
tools.description: Click a control by element_ref. auto first tries UIA Invoke/Toggle/Select, then message click at the control center; channel=input moves the real cursor. fallback_input=true (or VSP_INPUT_AUTOFALLBACK=1) enables SendInput after UIA/message fail. Prefer this over coordinate clicks.

fallback_input.description: Default false. When UIA/message paths fail, move the real cursor and use SendInput.

tools.name: click_text
tools.title: Click text on screen
tools.description: OCR the virtual display (or a region), find the first line containing text, click its center and return the before/after diff. Fallback for canvas apps where click_ref cannot find the element. fallback_input=true (or VSP_INPUT_AUTOFALLBACK=1) enables SendInput after UIA/message fail.

fallback_input.description: Default false. When UIA/message paths fail, move the real cursor and use SendInput.

require_unique.description: Fail with E_MULTIPLE_MATCHES when more than one line matches.

tools.name: find_element
tools.title: Find element
tools.description: Find UI Automation elements and return refs, bounds, state and snapshot_id. Falls back to MSAA when a window exposes no UIA content (Office legacy dialogs). control_type must be a valid UIA control type. role=document_body maps the document text surface.

control_type.description: UIA control type, e.g. Button, Edit, Document.

within.description: Container element_ref. Search only inside this element's subtree; the container must belong to the same tracked app. UIA-only (no MSAA fallback).

tools.name: gesture
tools.title: Gesture
tools.description: Composite mouse action: drag, scroll or move. Message mode cannot drag across windows; use mode=input for drags (this tool uses `mode`, not `channel`).

observe.description: Default true: capture a before/after diff and return observed.changed.

tools.name: get_element_text
tools.title: Get text
tools.description: Read text through TextPattern then ValuePattern. Use it to verify what you typed.

tools.name: get_environment
tools.title: Environment
tools.description: Read virtual display, display topology, foreground window and session state. foreground always reports hwnd/pid/process/elevated; titles are only included for tracked windows. ensure=true mounts/heals the virtual display first.

ensure.description: Mount or heal the virtual display before reading state.

tools.name: get_log
tools.title: Get log
tools.description: Read recent in-memory or file log entries, filtered by level/contains. Use it after E_INTERNAL or E_TIMEOUT.

include_other_clients.description: Include entries owned by other MCP clients. Default false.

tools.name: get_processes
tools.title: Get process snapshot
tools.description: Read-only process snapshot for long-running tasks (installers, builds, simulators). Filter by name substring or pid. Returns pid/name/session_id/elevated/started_at/uptime, and optionally the process's top-level windows. Use wait_for(condition.type=process) to block until a process exits instead of polling from the host shell. Exposes process names for the whole session; run in a trusted environment.

name.description: Process name substring, with or without .exe.

include_windows.description: Default false. Include window_count and the largest window (hwnd/title/class). Enabling it costs one window enumeration per call.

tools.name: get_ui_tree
tools.title: UI tree
tools.description: Read the pruned semantic tree of the tracked window. Nodes carry refs. By default it reuses the current snapshot generation, so existing refs stay valid; pass new_snapshot=true to invalidate old refs.

format.description: text is the compact line format.

new_snapshot.description: Advance the ref generation. Default false: keep existing refs valid.

tools.name: invoke_element
tools.title: Invoke element
tools.description: Invoke a control by ref. auto tries Invoke/Toggle/SelectionItem/ExpandCollapse/Legacy; pattern=default focuses and presses Space/Enter (useful for tree nodes).

select_text.description: Expand the control, find a descendant list item with this exact name, and select it. Returns E_MULTIPLE_MATCHES with candidates when ambiguous.

tools.name: launch_or_place_app
tools.title: Launch or attach app
tools.description: Start an application or attach to an existing window, move it onto the virtual display and maximize it. Returns pid/hwnd plus any owned dialogs discovered at attach time. If the process starts but shows no window (console/launcher/silent installer), returns launched=true with window=false plus alive/exit_code and keeps the process running (on_no_window=leave) without adding it to the job; on_no_window=kill terminates it. Prefer path for a new instance; window/hwnd only when you intentionally take over a running app. Single-instance apps may fall back to adopting an existing window: check `reused` and `warnings`; an adopted window is only moved back on release, never closed. Windows 11 Notepad can restore the previous session's tabs when launched without args; pass `args` or confirm the title with snapshot before typing. Set `place=false` to keep the current bounds (input tools may then reject the window if it is not on the virtual display); set `maximize=false` to move without maximizing.

window.description: Attach by window title. Ignores new_instance.

ensure_document.description: Default true. Word: Ctrl+N. PowerPoint: Ctrl+N then the blank-presentation tile. PowerPoint/Excel report document_ready_reason; apps without modeling return document_ready=null.

hwnd.description: Attach by window handle (dialogs/owned popups of a tracked app, or any top-level window). Takes precedence over path/window/pid.

place.description: Default true: move the window onto the virtual display. false keeps the current bounds; input tools may reject a window left on another monitor.

maximize.description: Default true: maximize after moving. false moves/resizes to the virtual display without maximizing.

on_no_window.description: Default leave. What to do when a newly started process shows no window: leave it running (console/launcher/installer, not added to the job) or kill its process tree.

tools.name: list_windows
tools.title: List top-level windows
tools.description: Read-only triage of visible top-level windows. Returns hwnd/pid/process/class/bounds, whether the window is on this session's virtual display, whether its pid is tracked by this session, and whether it runs at a higher integrity level. Titles of unmanaged windows are redacted (title_redacted=true), so title_contains only matches tracked windows. Reads all top-level windows in the session; run in a trusted environment. Use it before launch_or_place_app(hwnd=...) when a dialog or popup is not reachable through snapshot.

scope.description: Default all. tracked = pid belongs to a tracked app; unmanaged = everything else.

include_offscreen.description: Default true. false only returns windows whose center is on the virtual display.

title_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on titles. Only effective for tracked windows; unmanaged titles are redacted.

tools.name: match_visual
tools.title: Match visual
tools.description: Locate pixels on the virtual display: color connected components, single pixel, or PNG template match. Template matching is done at capture pixel scale; if the template comes from a different render scale/DPI, pass scales (0.5-2.0, default [1], max 5) to search.

scales.description: Template scales to try, e.g. [0.75,1,1.25]; default [1].

tools.name: press_keys
tools.title: Press keys
tools.description: Send a key combination or a sequence inside one foreground lease. System shortcuts (Win+*, Alt+Tab, Ctrl+Esc and variants) are rejected unless allow_system_keys=true.

observe.description: Default true: capture a before/after diff and return observed.changed.

hwnd.description: Target a specific tracked top-level window (for example a dialog). The window is brought to the foreground before keys are sent.

tools.name: read_screen_text
tools.title: Read screen text (OCR)
tools.description: OCR the virtual display or a region with the built-in Windows OCR engine. Use it for canvas apps (PowerPoint, charts, games) where UIA exposes no text. Optional query filters lines by substring.

tools.name: release_environment
tools.title: Release environment
tools.description: End the debug session: restore window placement, close only processes this session started, optionally remove the virtual display. on_dirty controls unsaved content. Default is abort: unsaved windows are kept and the display stays mounted. force/discard require allow_data_loss=true.

allow_data_loss.description: Required for on_dirty=force/discard when a tracked app may have unsaved content.

tools.name: run_script
tools.title: Run script
tools.description: Run a temporary PowerShell script with the current user token. Disabled unless the server was started with --allow-script. Output is UTF-8 and truncated to 64KB.

tools.name: set_display
tools.title: Resize virtual display
tools.description: Change the virtual display geometry at runtime (800-3840 x 600-2160, refresh 30-240) without restarting the daemon or changing the primary monitor. Changes the shared display for all clients in this profile; the display topology changes once, so the user may see a brief flicker. On failure the previous geometry is restored and E_DISPLAY_MODE is returned. reposition=true (default) moves tracked windows that would fall outside back inside.

reposition.description: Default true: move tracked windows that would fall outside the new display back inside it.

tools.name: set_element_value
tools.title: Set value
tools.description: Write a value by ref. ValuePattern first; allow_keyboard=true falls back to typing. Overwriting non-empty content requires allow_destructive=true.

strict_verify.description: Default false. When true, return E_VERIFY_FAILED if the value cannot be read back after writing.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.title: Snapshot
tools.description: One-call observation: compact semantic tree with refs, tracked windows, owned dialogs, focus and optional screenshot. Each call advances the ref generation: refs from an older snapshot return E_STALE_SNAPSHOT. (find_element/get_ui_tree reuse the current generation.)

include_screenshot.description: Default false; adds a scaled PNG.

annotate.description: Default false; draw element boxes and numbered labels on the screenshot. Implies include_screenshot.

include_values.description: Include text/value of text controls. Default true.

tools.name: type_text
tools.title: Type text
tools.description: Type text into the focused control. auto uses a pattern write, clipboard paste for long text, or SendInput as fallback; verify=true reads back through TextPattern/ValuePattern.

hwnd.description: Target a specific tracked top-level window (for example a dialog). Must belong to a tracked app; the window is brought to the foreground before typing.

strict_verify.description: Default false. When true, return E_VERIFY_FAILED if the text cannot be read back through TextPattern/ValuePattern.

pace_ms.description: Default 0. Sleep between chunks (ms). Self-drawn grids that drop characters often need chunk_chars=1 with pace_ms=15-30.

tools.name: wait_for
tools.title: Wait for condition
tools.description: Poll a condition on the server inside one call. type=element|color|window|process|pixel_diff|visual|text. Read-only: it never holds the write lock, so other observations keep working. process waits until a pid/name is running or gone (use it instead of polling from the host shell).

state.description: Default exited: block until the process is gone.
